title: Region-aware rollup retention and evidence compact protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a region-aware "compact rollup" retention mode that reduces long-term storage costs while preserving cryptographic evidence and per-region compliance semantics. The feature should produce compact, signed 'evidence bundles' that allow auditors and legal teams to reconstruct or verify retained records (prompts, responses, request logs, and derived metrics) without keeping full raw payloads indefinitely.
background: Customers operating in multiple jurisdictions ask for lower storage costs but need tamper-evident exports for audits and legal holds. Existing retention approaches either keep entire payloads (high cost) or sample/drop data (insufficient forensic guarantees). We need a middle path that is region-aware (respects residency rules), cost-efficient, and auditable.
goals: Define a compact rollup artifact format (signed manifest + deterministic transforms) for retaining request-level fidelity guarantees while minimizing stored bytes
Provide region-specific configuration so tenants can select different rollup windows and retention tiers per legal region
Enable on-demand full rehydration/export for legal/e-discovery use cases with integrity proofs
Expose console controls and APIs for configuring rollups and retrieving evidence bundles
non_goals: Replace existing full retention or per-route TTL features for customers who require raw payloads indefinitely
Perform heavy-weight per-request cryptographic signing inside the hot path; initial implementation may run as a background job/offline pipeline
scope: Platform + Dedicated + Private: design and implement server-side rollup pipeline, storage schema for rollups, console UI for configuration, and API for export. Private/VPC deployment must provide an operator guide and KMS integration notes.
success_metrics: Reduce long-term storage spend for customers using compact rollup mode by >=60% compared to raw retention at 90 days
Evidence bundle generation end-to-end time under SLA: 4 hours for 30 days of requests for a medium-sized tenant
Console adoption: 10% of customers with multi-region traffic enable rollup within 3 months of GA
Audit integrity: exported bundles validate with cryptographic proofs in >99.9% of test cases
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved by Security and Legal that describes cryptographic proof model and key management
API: POST /v1/retention/rollup-config to create per-region rollup configs and GET /v1/retention/evidence/{bundle_id} to retrieve bundle
Storage: rollups stored as compressed delta + manifest per region with SHA256 checksums and signer metadata
Console: UI to set rollup window (7/30/90/365 days), sampling granularity, and per-region retention tier
Export: On-demand evidence bundle includes manifest, index, compacted payloads, and integrity proofs; a validation tool verifies signatures and checksums
E2E tests that simulate a cross-region tenant and validate rehydration yields matchable request counts within deterministic tolerance
technical_considerations: Compaction algorithm: deterministic canonicalization of prompts/responses + delta compression of repeated prefixes to preserve retrievability
Integrity model: manifest signed by platform KMS; support for customer-managed KMS for Private deployments
Indexing: lightweight per-request index (timestamp, route, truncated hash) to allow targeted rehydration
Costs: balance CPU for compaction vs storage savings; initial pipeline should be asynchronous and batch-oriented
Compatibility: ensure rollup artifacts support both plaintext-scrubbed and PII-preserved modes based on tenant policy
ui_requirements: New Retention page section: 'Compact rollup' with per-region toggles, retention window dropdown, and preview of estimated monthly cost savings
Evidence export modal with progress, estimated completion, and download link for signed bundle
Audit logs entry for all rollup config changes with actor and timestamp
rollout_plan: 1) Design and security review (2 sprints) 2) Backend prototype + storage format experiments (3 sprints) 3) Console UI + API + tests (2 sprints) 4) Private deployment docs and KMS options (1 sprint) 5) Canary with small set of tenants and metrics collection. Feature gated by tenant opt-in.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Evidence format judged insufficient by auditors. Mitigation: early review with Legal and sample export sessions with customers
Risk: High CPU cost for compaction. Mitigation: batch jobs during off-peak and also provide configurable compaction windows
Risk: Misconfiguration leads to loss of region residency guarantees. Mitigation: validation checks at config time and guardrails in console/API
open_questions: What minimum retention fidelity level do regulated customers (financial, healthcare) require for different jurisdictions?
Should we support incremental proofs (Merkle trees) vs per-bundle signatures?
What SLAs customers expect for on-demand rehydration in Dedicated vs Private deployments?
